note: Published pins that do not resolve for an anonymous reader. This is a record, not an exemption from measurement: the pin-liveness gate reads it, reports every entry, and goes red again when an entry ages past its review window. It exists so the public record says plainly which addresses a reader cannot open, instead of leaving them to look live.

how_it_was_measured.probe: one probe per REVISION, at the canonical revision address, paced; a 429 or a host error is retried and never reported as a dead pin
